column.name: fk_oauth_client
column.description: Identifier of the OAuth client this third-party client is registered as.

column.name: registration_type
column.description: How the client became known: pre_registered (console). client_id_metadata_document and dynamic are reserved.

column.name: client_uri
column.description: Home page of the client, shown on the consent page.

column.name: logo_uri
column.description: HTTPS logo of the client, shown on the consent page.

column.name: redirect_uris
column.description: JSON list of exact redirect URIs.

column.name: scope_ceiling
column.description: JSON list of the scopes the client may ever be granted.

column.name: trust_level
column.description: Trust signal shown on the consent page: verified.

column.name: status
column.description: active or blocked.

column.name: uuid
column.description: Public identifier of the consent, carried in access and refresh tokens.

column.name: fk_customer
column.description: Customer who gave the consent. The foreign key cascades only on a hard delete; anonymization revokes through a plugin.

column.name: customer_reference
column.description: Reference of the customer who gave the consent.

column.name: principal_type
column.description: Who the client acts as: customer or company_user. Resolved by a principal resolver plugin.

column.name: principal_reference
column.description: Reference of the principal: customer reference for customer, company user uuid for company_user. No foreign key, so the schema does not depend on any principal module.

column.name: fk_store
column.description: Store the consent is bound to.

column.name: granted_scopes
column.description: JSON list of granted scopes; narrowed when a refresh finds that a scope filter removed one (event scopes_narrowed).

column.name: status
column.description: active or revoked; expired is reserved for the housekeeping command.

column.name: expires_at
column.description: End of the consent, chosen on the consent page.

column.name: last_used_at
column.description: Last call made under the consent, written at most hourly.

column.name: revoked_by
column.description: customer, client, company_admin, system_reuse_detected, system_code_replay, system_principal_inactive or system_client_blocked.

column.name: refresh_token_identifier
column.description: Identifier of the one live refresh token issued under the consent, in the form consent uuid, a dot, then random hex.

column.name: event
column.description: granted, re_consented, scopes_narrowed, revoked, reuse_detected or code_replayed; expired is reserved for the housekeeping command.

column.name: actor
column.description: Same values as spy_agentic_commerce_consent.revoked_by, plus system_scope_filter for scopes_narrowed; granted and re_consented always have customer.

column.name: scopes
column.description: JSON list of the consent scopes after the event.

column.name: client_name
column.description: Client name shown on the consent page; filled on granted and re_consented only.
